All words EVP A1, prompts 8-14 words. Item order identical across forms: 1-2 controlled gap-fill, 3-4 controlled choice, 5-6 error correction, 7-8 free production (target_form_0_1_2), 9 transfer. Review round 1: slots 5-6 now contain a wrong kin word that must be replaced (uncle/aunt/cousin/grandmother/grandfather, all A1); C-4 now aunt.
